about: Move a vehicle's registration from one person or company to another.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Copy of the official power of attorney
fees: 350 AED for private or public light vehicles
400 AED private and 650 AED public for vehicles over 3 and up to 12 tonnes
800 AED private and 1,000 AED public for vehicles over 12 tonnes
Motorcycles 200 AED private, 400 AED public; buses, trailers and machinery have their own rates on the page
timing: The person receiving the vehicle enters an OTP code sent to them
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
an Integrated Transport Center service centre
